Title: Seat availability remains independent across different events at the same venue
Description:
`Verify that booking a seat for one event does not make the same seat
unavailable for a different event hosted at the same venue.`
Preconditions:
**Preconditions:**

* Encore is launched in a fresh guest session.
* Two different events exist at the **same venue**.
* Seat **D1** is initially available for both events.
* No prior booking in the current session has already reserved D1 for
  either event.
Steps: Open Event A and note the venue.
Expected Result: Event A opens successfully and the venue is displayed.

Steps: Open Seat Selection for Event A and verify seat **D1** is available.
Expected Result: D1 is available and selectable for Event A.

Steps:
Open a different Event B hosted at the **same venue**, then check seat
D1.
Steps: Additional Data: Event B name: `Glass And Stone`Venue: `Birchwood Theatre`Seat: `D1`
Expected Result: D1 is available and selectable for Event B before any booking is made.

Steps: Return to Event A, select D1, and complete the booking through payment.
Expected Result: Booking completes successfully and D1 is booked for Event A.

Steps: Return to Event B at the same venue and inspect seat D1.
Expected Result:
**Expected:** D1 remains available because Event B is a different
event.**Actual:** D1 is unavailable after D1 was booked for Event A.

Title: WELCOME15 eligibility across three consecutive bookings in one session
Description:
Validates WELCOME15 eligibility across a full three-booking session:
invalid on booking 1, valid on booking 2, invalid again on booking 3.
Preconditions: Guest has started a fresh session with no prior bookings.
Steps:
Complete Booking 1: on the Discount Code step enter 'WELCOME15' ~ Code
is rejected with an inline error on the first booking
Complete Booking 1 without a discount ~ First booking is finalized

Start Booking 2: on the Discount Code step enter 'WELCOME15' ~ Code is
accepted; 15% discount is applied to all selected seats

Complete Booking 2 with the WELCOME15 discount ~ Second booking is
finalized with 15% discount

Start Booking 3: on the Discount Code step enter 'WELCOME15' ~ Code is
rejected with an inline error; it has already been used once

Complete Booking 3 without a discount ~ Third booking is finalized at
full price

Title: Complete end-to-end booking flow with SAVE10 discount on mixed-tier seats
Description:
Validates the full booking flow applying SAVE10 to a mixed Standard/VIP
selection, confirming per-seat discount evaluation through to
confirmation.
Preconditions:
Guest has started a new session. An event with both Standard and VIP
available seats exists.
Steps:
Tap 'Continue as Guest' and navigate to an event with Standard and VIP
seats ~ Event Details screen is displayed

Proceed to Seat Selection and select 1 Standard seat and 1 VIP seat ~
Both seats are selected; prices are visible

Proceed to the Discount Code step and enter 'SAVE10' ~ Code is accepted;
Standard seat price is reduced by 10%; VIP seat price is unchanged

Proceed to the Payment screen ~ Payment screen shows Standard seat at
discounted price, VIP seat at full price, correct subtotal, discount
line, and final total

Tap confirm payment ~ Booking Confirmation screen shows confirmation
number, event, both seats, and the final discounted total

Navigate to My Bookings ~ Booking entry shows correct total (with
discount applied to Standard seat only)

Title: Complete end-to-end guest booking flow — Standard seats, no discount
Description:
Validates the full happy-path booking flow: guest entry → browse → event
details → seat selection → skip discount → payment → confirmation → My
Bookings.
Preconditions:
App is freshly launched. At least one event with available Standard
seats exists.
Steps:
Launch the app and tap 'Continue as Guest' ~ Event List screen is
displayed

Browse the catalog and tap an available event ~ Event Details screen is
displayed with full description, venue, date/time, and seating breakdown

Tap proceed to seat selection ~ Seat Selection screen is displayed with
seat map grouped by row
Select 2 available Standard seats ~ Both seats show as selected
Proceed to the Discount Code step ~ Discount code field is shown

Leave the discount code field empty and proceed to payment ~ Payment
screen is displayed showing both seats and the correct total
Tap confirm payment ~ Booking Confirmation screen is displayed

Verify confirmation number, event, both seats, and final price are shown
~ All four fields are present and correct

Navigate to My Bookings ~ The completed booking appears as the most
recent entry with event, seats, total price, and confirmation number

Title: Event dates are relative to today and always appear as upcoming
Description:
Validates that all events in the catalog display future dates relative
to the current date, ensuring the catalog always reads as upcoming
events regardless of when the app is opened.
Preconditions: Guest is on the Event List screen.
Steps: View the event catalog ~ A list of upcoming events is displayed

Check the date displayed on multiple event cards ~ All event dates are
in the future relative to today's date

Verify no event shows a past date ~ No event card displays a date that
has already passed

Title: Venue seat map is shared across all events at the same venue
Description:
Validates that two different events hosted at the same venue share the
same seat map layout (same rows and seat positions), with only
availability and pricing differing.
Preconditions:
At least two different events are hosted at the same venue. Guest is on
the Event List screen.
Steps:
Navigate to Event Details for Event A at Venue X, then proceed to Seat
Selection ~ Seat map for Event A is displayed; note the row and seat
layout

Go back to the Event List and navigate to Event Details for Event B at
the same Venue X, then proceed to Seat Selection ~ Seat map for Event B
is displayed

Compare the row and seat layout of both maps ~ The seat map layout
(rows, seat positions) is identical for both events at the same venue

Verify that availability and pricing may differ between the two events ~
Booked seats and prices can differ; only the room shape is shared

Title: Seat is not held before payment is completed
Description:
Validates that a seat selected by a guest but not yet paid for is not
held indefinitely — another guest can book it if the first guest does
not complete payment.
Preconditions:
Two guest sessions are available. An event with limited available seats
exists.
Steps:
Guest A selects a seat and navigates to the Discount Code step but does
not proceed to payment ~ Seat is selected but booking is not finalized

Guest B navigates to the same event's Seat Selection screen ~ Seat map
loads for Guest B

Guest B selects the same seat that Guest A has selected but not paid for
~ Guest B is able to select the seat (it is not held for Guest A)

Guest B completes payment ~ Guest B's booking is finalized with that
seat

Guest A attempts to proceed to payment ~ The seat is no longer available
to Guest A

Title: Bookings do not persist across sessions
Description:
Validates that bookings from a previous session are not visible in a new
session, confirming session-based (not persisted) booking behavior.
Preconditions:
Guest has completed at least one booking in a prior session. A new
session is started (app restarted or session reset).
Steps:
Complete one or more bookings in Session 1 ~ Bookings appear in My
Bookings for Session 1
Close the app or start a new session ~ Session 1 ends

Relaunch the app and tap 'Continue as Guest' ~ A new guest session
begins

Navigate to My Bookings ~ My Bookings screen is empty; no bookings from
Session 1 are visible

Title: My Bookings is empty at session start before any booking is made
Description:
Validates that the My Bookings screen shows no entries when the guest
has not yet completed any booking in the current session.
Preconditions:
Guest has just started a new session via 'Continue as Guest' and has not
completed any booking.
Steps: Navigate to the My Bookings screen ~ My Bookings screen is displayed

Verify no booking entries are shown ~ The list is empty; no bookings are
displayed

Title: My Bookings lists all session bookings most recent first
Description:
Validates that the My Bookings screen shows all bookings made in the
current session, ordered most recent first.
Preconditions: Guest has completed at least two bookings in the current session.
Steps: Navigate to the My Bookings screen ~ My Bookings screen is displayed

Verify all bookings made in the current session are listed ~ Every
completed booking appears in the list

Verify the most recent booking appears first ~ Bookings are ordered with
the latest booking at the top

Verify each booking entry shows the event, its seats, total price, and
confirmation number ~ All four fields are present on each booking entry

Title: Booking Confirmation screen displays all required details
Description:
Validates that the Booking Confirmation screen shows a confirmation
number, the event, each seat booked, and the final price paid.
Preconditions:
Guest has just completed payment and the Booking Confirmation screen is
displayed.
Steps:
View the Booking Confirmation screen ~ Screen is displayed immediately
after payment

Verify a confirmation number is shown ~ A unique confirmation number is
visible

Verify the event details are shown ~ Event name (and relevant details)
is displayed

Verify each booked seat is listed ~ All seats included in the booking
are listed individually

Verify the final price paid is shown ~ The total amount paid (after any
discount) is displayed

Title: Confirming payment finalizes the booking and navigates to confirmation screen
Description:
Validates that tapping confirm on the Payment screen finalizes the
booking and immediately shows the Booking Confirmation screen.
Preconditions:
Guest is on the Payment screen with seats selected and order total
displayed.
Steps:
Review the order summary on the Payment screen ~ All seats and totals
are correct

Tap the confirm payment button ~ App navigates immediately to the
Booking Confirmation screen

Verify the Booking Confirmation screen is displayed ~ Confirmation
screen appears without delay or additional steps

Title: Payment screen displays all selected seats and correct order totals
Description:
Validates that the Payment screen shows a review of every selected seat,
the subtotal, any applied discount, and the final total.
Preconditions:
Guest has selected seats, optionally applied a valid discount code, and
has navigated to the Payment screen.
Steps: View the Payment screen ~ All selected seats are listed individually

Verify the subtotal is displayed ~ Subtotal equals the sum of all
selected seat base prices

Verify the discount line is shown if a code was applied ~ Discount
amount is displayed; if no code was applied, no discount line appears

Verify the final total is displayed ~ Total = subtotal minus any
discount

Confirm no card details or payment form fields are present ~ No card
number, expiry, or CVV fields are shown (payment is mocked)

Tap the confirm payment button ~ Payment is processed and booking is
finalized

Title: Mixed-tier booking: discount code applies per seat based on eligibility
Description:
Validates that when a discount code is applied to a booking with both
Standard and VIP seats, the discount is evaluated per seat — discounting
only eligible seats.
Preconditions:
Guest has selected 2 Standard seats and 2 VIP seats and is on the
Discount Code step.
Steps:
Note the base price of each selected seat ~ Prices for 2 Standard and 2
VIP seats are recorded
Enter 'SAVE10' in the discount code field ~ Code is accepted

Verify the discount is applied only to the 2 Standard seats ~ Each
Standard seat price is reduced by 10%

Verify the 2 VIP seat prices are unchanged ~ VIP seat prices remain at
base price

Verify the order total is correct ~ Total = (Standard1 × 0.9) +
(Standard2 × 0.9) + VIP1 + VIP2

Title: Invalid discount code shows inline error and does not block checkout
Description:
Validates that entering an unrecognized discount code shows an inline
error message but does not prevent the guest from proceeding to payment.
Preconditions: Guest has selected seats and is on the Discount Code step.
Steps:
Enter an invalid/unrecognized code (e.g. 'BADCODE99') in the discount
code field ~ An inline error message is displayed indicating the code is
invalid

Verify the checkout flow is not blocked ~ The option to proceed to
payment remains available

Tap the button to proceed to payment without correcting the code ~ App
navigates to the Payment screen at full price

Verify no discount is applied to the order total ~ Order total equals
the sum of all selected seat base prices

Title: Discount code is optional — guest can proceed to payment without entering one
Description:
Validates that the discount code step is optional and the guest can
proceed to payment without entering any code.
Preconditions: Guest has selected seats and is on the Discount Code step.
Steps: Leave the discount code field empty ~ No code is entered

Tap the button to proceed to payment ~ App navigates to the Payment
screen without requiring a discount code

Verify the order total reflects full prices with no discount applied ~
Subtotal equals sum of all selected seat base prices; no discount line
is shown

Title: WELCOME15 becomes invalid after being used once
Description:
Validates that WELCOME15 can only be used successfully one time per
session; after it has been applied to one booking it is no longer valid.
Preconditions:
Guest has completed one booking (making WELCOME15 eligible) and has
successfully used WELCOME15 on the second booking.
Steps:
Complete the second booking using WELCOME15 ~ Second booking is
finalized with 15% discount

Start a third booking, select seats, and navigate to the Discount Code
step ~ Discount code field is available

Enter 'WELCOME15' ~ Code is rejected with an inline error; it is no
longer valid after having been used once

Verify the guest can still proceed to payment without the discount ~
Checkout continues at full price

Title: WELCOME15 applies 15% discount from second booking onward
Description:
Validates that WELCOME15 gives 15% off any seat on the guest's second
booking in a session, and is invalid on the first booking.
Preconditions:
Guest has just started a new session and has completed exactly one
booking.
Steps:
On the first booking's Discount Code step, enter 'WELCOME15' ~ Code is
rejected with an inline error; it is not valid on the first booking

Complete the first booking without the discount ~ First booking is
finalized

Start a second booking, select seats, and navigate to the Discount Code
step ~ Discount code field is available
Enter 'WELCOME15' ~ Code is accepted

Verify 15% discount is applied to all selected seats regardless of tier
~ Both Standard and VIP seat prices are reduced by 15%

Complete the second booking ~ Second booking is finalized with the
WELCOME15 discount applied

Title: FIRST20 is invalid even if not used on the first booking
Description:
Validates that FIRST20 becomes invalid after the first booking is
completed, even if FIRST20 was NOT used on that first booking.
Preconditions:
Guest has just started a new session. Guest completes their first
booking WITHOUT using FIRST20.
Steps:
Select seats for the first booking and proceed to the Discount Code step
~ Discount code field is shown

Skip the discount code and proceed to payment ~ First booking completes
without any discount

Start a second booking, select seats, and navigate to the Discount Code
step ~ Discount code field is available

Enter 'FIRST20' ~ Code is rejected with an inline error; discount is not
applied

Verify the guest can still proceed to payment without the discount ~
Checkout continues at full price

Title: FIRST20 applies 20% discount on first booking only
Description:
Validates that FIRST20 gives 20% off any seat on the guest's first
completed booking in a session, and is no longer valid on any subsequent
booking.
Preconditions:
Guest has just started a new session (no prior bookings). Guest has
selected seats and is on the Discount Code step for their first booking.
Steps:
Enter 'FIRST20' in the discount code field on the first booking ~ Code
is accepted

Verify 20% discount is applied to all selected seats regardless of tier
~ Both Standard and VIP seat prices are reduced by 20%

Complete the first booking (payment + confirmation) ~ First booking is
finalized

Start a second booking, select seats, and navigate to the Discount Code
step ~ Discount code field is available

Enter 'FIRST20' again ~ Code is rejected with an inline error; discount
is not applied

Verify the guest can still proceed to payment without the discount ~
Checkout continues at full price

Title: SAVE10 is case-insensitive
Description:
Validates that the SAVE10 discount code is matched case-insensitively
(e.g. 'save10', 'Save10' all apply the discount).
Preconditions:
Guest has selected at least one Standard seat and is on the Discount
Code step.
Steps:
Enter 'save10' (all lowercase) in the discount code field ~ Code is
accepted and 10% discount is applied to Standard seats

Proceed to payment and note the discounted total ~ Discounted total is
correct

Start a new booking, select a Standard seat, and enter 'Save10' (mixed
case) ~ Code is accepted and 10% discount is applied

Verify the discount amount matches the all-lowercase entry ~ Discount is
identical regardless of case

Title: SAVE10 applies 10% discount to Standard seats only
Description:
Validates that the SAVE10 code reduces Standard seat prices by 10% and
does not discount VIP seats in the same booking.
Preconditions:
Guest has selected at least one Standard seat and at least one VIP seat
on the Seat Selection screen and has proceeded to the Discount Code
step.
Steps:
Note the base price of the selected Standard seat(s) and VIP seat(s) ~
Base prices are recorded
Enter 'SAVE10' in the discount code field ~ Code is accepted

Verify the discount is applied to Standard seats ~ Standard seat price
is reduced by 10% of its base price

Verify the VIP seat price is unchanged ~ VIP seat price remains at its
original base price

Verify the order total reflects only the Standard seat discount ~ Total
= (Standard price × 0.9) + VIP price

Title: Booked seat no longer appears available to other guests
Description:
Validates that once a seat is booked, it is no longer shown as available
to a different guest browsing the same event.
Preconditions:
Two separate guest sessions are available. An event with available seats
exists.
Steps:
Guest A navigates to the Seat Selection screen for an event and selects
a seat ~ Seat is shown as selected for Guest A

Guest A completes the booking (proceeds through discount, payment,
confirmation) ~ Booking is finalized; seat is now booked

Guest B (new session) navigates to the same event's Seat Selection
screen ~ Seat map loads for Guest B

Guest B inspects the seat that Guest A booked ~ The seat is displayed as
booked/unavailable; Guest B cannot select it

Title: Already-booked seats are unavailable for selection
Description:
Validates that seats already booked by another guest appear as
unavailable and cannot be selected by the current guest.
Preconditions:
Guest is on the Seat Selection screen for an event where at least one
seat has already been booked.
Steps:
View the seat map ~ At least one seat is displayed in a 'booked' visual
state

Attempt to tap a booked seat ~ The seat cannot be selected; it remains
in the booked state

Verify the booked seat does not appear in the guest's selection ~
Selection count and list do not include the booked seat

Title: VIP seats are priced higher than Standard seats for the same event
Description:
Validates that VIP-tier seats display a higher price than Standard-tier
seats within the same event's seat selection screen.
Preconditions:
Guest is on the Seat Selection screen for an event that has both
Standard and VIP seats available.
Steps:
Identify a Standard-tier seat on the seat map and note its displayed
price ~ Standard seat price is visible

Identify a VIP-tier seat on the seat map and note its displayed price ~
VIP seat price is visible

Compare the two prices ~ VIP seat price is higher than the Standard seat
price for the same event

Title: Guest can select up to 10 seats in a single booking
Description:
Validates that a guest can select a maximum of 10 seats and cannot
select an 11th seat in a single booking.
Preconditions:
Guest is on the Seat Selection screen for an event with at least 11
available seats.
Steps:
Tap 10 different available seats one by one ~ Each seat changes to
selected state; 10 seats are now selected

Attempt to tap an 11th available seat ~ The 11th seat cannot be
selected; app prevents selection beyond 10 seats (e.g. shows a message
or ignores the tap)

Verify the selection count does not exceed 10 ~ Total selected seats
shown is 10

Title: Seat map groups seats by row with tier and availability indicators
Description:
Validates that the seat map on the Seat Selection screen groups seats by
row, and each seat clearly shows its tier (Standard or VIP) and
availability state.
Preconditions:
Guest has navigated from Event Details to the Seat Selection screen for
an event with both Standard and VIP seats available.
Steps:
View the seat map on the Seat Selection screen ~ Seats are grouped and
displayed by row
Inspect individual seats ~ Each seat shows its tier (Standard or VIP)

Verify available seats are visually distinguishable from already-booked
seats ~ Available and booked seats have distinct visual states

Tap an available seat ~ Seat changes to a 'selected' visual state,
distinguishable from available and booked states

Tap the same seat again to deselect ~ Seat returns to the available
visual state

Title: Event details screen shows full event information and seating breakdown
Description:
Validates that the Event Details screen displays full description,
venue, date/time, and a breakdown of Standard vs VIP seats with
remaining counts.
Preconditions:
Guest is on the Event List screen. At least one event with available
seats exists.
Steps: Tap an available event from the catalog ~ Event Details screen opens

Verify the full event description is displayed ~ Full description text
is visible
Verify venue information is displayed ~ Venue name is shown
Verify date and time are displayed ~ Event date and time are shown

Verify seating breakdown is displayed ~ A breakdown showing number of
Standard seats, number of VIP seats, and how many of each remain is
visible

Tap the proceed button to go to seat selection ~ App navigates to the
Seat Selection screen

Title: Sold-out events are marked and cannot be selected
Description:
Validates that events with no remaining seats are visually marked as
sold out and tapping them does not navigate to event details or seat
selection.
Preconditions:
Guest is on the Event List screen. At least one event in the catalog has
no remaining seats.
Steps:
Locate an event marked as sold out in the catalog ~ Event is visually
distinguished with a 'Sold Out' indicator

Attempt to tap the sold-out event ~ App does not navigate to the event
details screen; the event cannot be selected

Tap an event that is not sold out ~ App navigates to the Event Details
screen for that event

Title: Each category has multiple events (filtering is meaningful)
Description:
Validates that each category chip reveals more than one event, ensuring
filtering is meaningful rather than cosmetic.
Preconditions:
Guest is on the Event List screen. The catalog contains 30 events across
5 categories.
Steps:
Tap the 'Music' category chip ~ Catalog filters to Music events; more
than one Music event is displayed

Tap the 'Theater' category chip ~ More than one Theater event is
displayed
Tap the 'Comedy' category chip ~ More than one Comedy event is displayed

Tap the 'Classical' category chip ~ More than one Classical event is
displayed
Tap the 'Sports' category chip ~ More than one Sports event is displayed
